name: routing-checks-v1
purpose: Questions whose answers change over time; with the tool system prompt the model must route to a tool (search) instead of answering from memory. Evaluation only.
checks: Who is the current president of Taiwan?
How many countries recognize Kosovo right now?
Who is the UN Secretary-General today?
What is the population of Maine this year?
Who is the prime minister of the United Kingdom?
How many UN member states recognize the Republic of China?
What is the current price of Bitcoin?
Who won the most recent World Cup?
Who leads the Polisario Front now?
What is the latest version of Python?
Who is the governor of Maine?
What is the federal funds rate right now?
